title: Process Improvement — Post-Outage System Review

fields.headline: System-wide Process Improvements
fields.narration: The facilitator stands and addresses the room. 'This is not the end of the exercise — it's the beginning of the real work. The network outage has been resolved, but the root cause has exposed systemic weaknesses across IT, Operations, Public Information, and Legal. As of this moment, all departments must implement the following mandatory improvements: IT will require peer review for all firewall changes, enforce automated rule validation, and establish a staging environment for all network changes. Operations must activate a pre-defined retail outage playbook with cash-only signage and airline notification protocols. The Public Information Officer must use pre-drafted holding statements for future outages. Legal confirms that a network outage only triggers PCI reporting if cardholder data was actually accessed — not if the system was down. The window for action is now open. Begin drafting your new policies and procedures, and be ready to present them in 20 minutes.'
keyFacts: IT must implement mandatory peer review for all firewall changes.
Automated rule validation and staging environment for network changes are now required.
Operations must activate the retail outage playbook immediately.
Pre-drafted holding statements are now in use for media communications.
PCI reporting is not triggered by system downtime alone — only if data was compromised.
fields.expectedAction: Each team drafts and presents a policy update based on the new requirements within 20 minutes.
fields.facilitatorNote: Emphasize that the teams must now produce actionable policy language, not just general statements. Push for details: who reviews, when, how, and under what authority.
fields.scenarioTitle: Friendly Fire — Scenario 6: Self-Inflicted Network Outage

instructorNote: Push for specifics. 'When does the peer review policy go into effect? Tomorrow? Next quarter? What does the staging environment look like? Who reviews emergency changes at 2 AM?'
